quarterly_data.quarter: Amkor Technology press release: Amkor Technology and NVIDIA Advance Strategic Partnership (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer NVIDIA: Amkor announced a new $1.3 billion agreement with NVIDIA for additional capacity-expansion investments in South Korea, building on the companies' recent Arizona collaboration; with it, Amkor's multi-year agreements with NVIDIA in Arizona and South Korea total $3 billion. Amkor says the prepayments align its manufacturing capacity with NVIDIA's long-term growth plans.

contracts.source: Amkor Technology press release: Amkor Technology and NVIDIA Advance Strategic Partnership (10-21-2026)
contracts.signal: New $1.3 billion agreement supporting further Amkor expansion in South Korea for capacity expansion initiatives with NVIDIA, building on the recent Arizona collaboration; Amkor's multi-year agreements with NVIDIA in Arizona and South Korea now total $3 billion. The prepayments align Amkor's manufacturing capacity with NVIDIA's long-term growth plans and support increasing demand for advanced packaging solutions. CEO Kevin Engel: the investments 'strengthen our ability to support customers through our operations in both the United States and South Korea'. NVIDIA EVP Operations Debora Shoquist: the work with Amkor helps NVIDIA scale production of current and next-generation platforms.
contracts.value: $1.3 billion (South Korea agreement); $3 billion total (Arizona and South Korea)
